stories.headline: OpenAI acquires TBPN
stories.summary: OpenAI acquires TBPN to accelerate global conversations around AI and support independent media, expanding dialogue with builders, businesses, and the broader tech community.

stories.headline: Good ideas do not need lots of lies in order to gain public acceptance (2008)
Codex now offers more flexible pricing for teams
stories.summary: Codex now includes pay-as-you-go pricing for ChatGPT Business and Enterprise, providing teams a more flexible option to start and scale adoption.

stories.headline: Gradient Labs gives every bank customer an AI account manager
stories.summary: Gradient Labs uses GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.4 mini and nano to power AI agents that automate banking support workflows with low latency and high reliability.

Accelerating the next phase of AI
stories.summary: OpenAI raises $122 billion in new funding to expand frontier AI globally, invest in next-generation compute, and meet growing demand for ChatGPT, Codex, and enterprise AI.

stories.summary: AI for Disaster Response in Asia: OpenAI Workshop with Gates Foundation

stories.headline: OpenAI acquires TBPN, the buzzy founder-led business talk show
stories.summary: TBPN, Silicon Valley's cult-favorite tech podcast, will operate independently, even as it's overseen by chief political operative Chris Lehane.

stories.headline: ElevenLabs releases a new AI-powered music-generation app
stories.summary: ElevenMusic lets users create and remix songs using text prompts. The new app suggests ElevenLabs wants to be more than just a voice model company.

stories.headline: NASA astronauts prove that sending an email really is rocket science
stories.summary: NASA Artemis II commander Reid Wiseman faced the most earthly possible conflict while in outer space: his Outlook wasn't working.

stories.headline: Microsoft takes on AI rivals with three new foundational models
stories.summary: MAI released models that can transcribe voice into text as well as generate audio and images after the group's formation six months ago.

stories.headline: United’s mobile app now shows TSA wait times at select airports
stories.summary: The TSA wait times feature is one of many new additions to the United app, including automatic rebooking assistance and real-time time weather radar maps.
